key_points: No thesis-changing catalyst, earnings surprise, guidance revision, regulatory event, or major corporate announcement is present.
Institutional buying headlines are largely offset by reported selling, making the flow signal low quality and near-term noise.
The roughly 3%-4% decline reflects pre-earnings de-risking and weak semiconductor-equipment sentiment rather than a new fundamental negative.
A 53% year-to-date rally and bullish expectations increase downside sensitivity if upcoming results or guidance disappoint.
The approaching earnings report is the next material catalyst, but current headlines mainly describe positioning and expectations.
